-- test: endpoints lists availability and the serving command --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} endpoints
-- expect:regex --
ENDPOINT\s+AVAILABLE\s+KUBECTL ACTUATOR SUPPORT
-- expect:regex --
health\s+true\s+health
-- expect:regex --
loggers\s+true\s+logger
-- expect:regex --
scheduledtasks\s+true\s+scheduledtasks
-- expect:regex --
configprops\s+true\s+-
-- expect:not --
mappings
-- expect:not --
self


-- test: endpoints name output is plain --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} endpoints -o name
-- expect:stdout --
health
-- expect:stdout --
loggers
-- expect:not:stdout --
COMMAND


-- test: endpoints structured output passes the index through --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} endpoints -o json
-- expect:jsonpath --
pods.0.data._links.health
-- expect:jsonpath --
pods.0.data._links.self
